newsitem.title: USA: Brooks Fiber files for arbitration.
newsitem.headline: Brooks Fiber files for arbitration.

text.p: Brooks Fiber Properties Inc said Monday it filed for abritration in connection with its pursuit of equitable co-carrier agreements with U S West Communications Group.
Brooks, a local telecommunications services company, said it filed with the Arizona Corporation Commission and the New Mexico Corporation.
To date, the parties have not reached final agreements and U S West has failed to reach agreement with any carrier in the 14 states in which it operates, Brooks said.
Brooks said it and U S West have agreed to continue negotiating during the arbitration period which ends December 27, 1996.
Prices are subject to commission determination or review under the Telecommunications Act of 1996 and a Federal Communications Commission order on interconnection issued August 8, 1996.
Brooks Fiber has 29 networks in 16 states operating or under construction and plans to have 30 networks by the end of 1996 and 50 by the end of 1998.
